name: CCW 27 Chronic Conditions File
description: Annual beneficiary-level file with indicators and first occurrence dates for 27 CMS Chronic Conditions Warehouse conditions, based on standardized claims criteria and available for 2003-2016.

content.enrol_src: String: Source of enrollment or data source flag
content.ami: Int32: Indicator for whether beneficiary met CCW criteria for acute myocardial infarction (AMI) by year-end. Values: 0 = did not meet claims criteria or lacked full FFS coverage; 1 = met claims criteria but lacked full FFS coverage; 2 = did not meet claims criteria but had FFS coverage; 3 = met claims criteria and had FFS coverage
content.ami_ever: Date32[day]: Date first met CCW criteria for AMI
content.alzh: Int32: Indicator for whether beneficiary met CCW criteria for Alzheimer’s Disease by year-end. Values: 0–3 as above
content.alzh_ever: Date32[day]: Date first met CCW criteria for Alzheimer’s Disease
content.alzh_demen: Int32: Indicator for whether beneficiary met CCW criteria for Alzheimer's Disease and Related Disorders or Senile Dementia by year-end. Values: 0–3 as above
